OPERATIONAL WORKFLOW

How Project Coordination Works

A friction-free four-stage pipeline connecting your sales intake directly to CAD drafting.

01 1-Minute Dispatch
PROJECT INTAKE

Submit Project & Requirements

Provide the property address, prelim CAD/proposal, utility bill, and specific survey scope (roof planes, electrical panel, battery storage, attic access) via our fast dispatch portal or API.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • Address & Geo-coordinates
  • Utility Bill & Meter ID
  • Prelim Proposal / Layout
  • Special Access Notes
02 < 4hr Dispatch
DISPATCH & COORDINATION

Surveyor Matched & Scheduled

Our operations dispatch team immediately assigns a vetted local site surveyor equipped with certified safety gear, digital pitch gauges, multimeters, and drones. We confirm site access directly.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • Vetted Field Network
  • SLA Dispatch Notice
  • Customer Access Coordination
  • Safety & PPE Compliance
03 Strict QA Checklist
FIELD EXECUTION

Comprehensive Field Survey

The surveyor performs an exhaustive on-site audit: 36-photo standard, MSP dead-front busbar verification, rafter dimensions, pitch measurements, obstruction coordinates, and battery clearances.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • 36-Photo Geotagged Set
  • MSP Dead-Front Inspection
  • Rafter & Truss Measurement
  • Obstruction Offsets (X/Y)
04 48–72hr Turnaround
QA & DELIVERY

CAD-Ready Package Delivered

Every photo, measurement, and electrical reading undergoes internal triple-check QA before release. Your engineering and drafting team receives an organized, categorized CAD-ready package.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • One-Touch CAD Formatting
  • Single-Line Diagram Ready
  • Defect-Free Guarantee
  • Cloud Storage / Webhook
FIELD AUDIT SCOPE

Comprehensive Site Survey Disciplines

Our coordinated field surveyors execute exhaustive inspections across all physical, structural, and electrical parameters required for solar permitting and installation.

ROOF & STRUCTURAL

Roof Geometry & Condition Audit

Physical validation of aerial models. We document every roof plane, pitch angle, material layer, and obstruction coordinate to give CAD designers total spatial confidence.

Roof Dimensions & Pitch Gauges Shingle / Tile Layer Count Attic Rafter & Truss Spacing Obstruction X/Y Offsets Chimney & Skylight Clearances Shading & Horizon Factors
ELECTRICAL & MSP

Electrical Service & Interconnection

Complete electrical nameplate documentation. We remove panel dead-fronts to verify busbar ratings, main breaker capacity, and NEC 705.12 interconnection viability.

Main Service Panel (MSP) Model Busbar Amp Rating Verification Main Disconnect Amperage 120% Rule Calculation Data Utility Meter Serial & Socket Type Grounding Electrode Verification
STORAGE & BESS

Battery & Gateway Spatial Clearances

Specialized storage site checks. We verify NFPA 855 wall clearances, gateway locations, and conduit pathways for Tesla Powerwall, Enphase, and SolarEdge systems.

NFPA 855 Window/Door Offsets Microgrid Gateway Placement Critical Loads Subpanel Audit Conduit Routing Path & Distance Wall Framing & Stud Capacity Garage Vehicle Impact Checks
SITE DOCUMENTATION

Complete Geotagged Visual Package

High-resolution documentary photography. Every property angle, street elevation, meter context, and attic framing connection delivered in a structured digital package.

4 Exterior Building Elevations High-Resolution Macro Labels Geotagged & Timestamped Drone Thermal / RGB (Optional) Cloud Portal Download ZIP One-Touch CAD Compatibility
